subject: Onboarding financial pathway and evidence handoff for NorthGate (residency + HSM + audit logs)
messages:
From: Alice Green <alice.green@northgatehealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Nash <tom.nash@northgatehealth.com>, NorthGate Procurement <procurement@northgatehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Onboarding financial pathway and evidence handoff for NorthGate (residency + HSM + audit logs)

Thanks Soojin — quick clarification before I loop legal/procurement: NorthGate intends to run a private deployment in our us-east cloud with HSM-based keying, and we need audit log retention at 7 years (per audit). From a procurement perspective we are trying to understand: 1) how you suggest amortizing the one-time HSM onboarding vs ongoing audit log storage; and 2) whether you can commit to staggered evidence delivery (SOC2 attestation package, HSM attestation, ingest proofs) tied to invoice milestones.

Can you sketch the typical payment milestone cadence you recommend for customers doing a sovereign/on-prem-like setup? We will likely seek a 12–18 month commercial term.

—Alice
Alice Green
VP, IT Compliance
NorthGate Health

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Green <alice.green@northgatehealth.com>
Cc: Tom Nash <tom.nash@northgatehealth.com>, NorthGate Procurement <procurement@northgatehealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 6 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding financial pathway and evidence handoff for NorthGate (residency + HSM + audit logs)

Alice — thanks for the clear ask. Short answer: we recommend a hybrid approach (split implementation + recurring) with milestone-tied evidence handoffs so procurement can release payments after verification points. Below is a concise proposal I can convert to an SOW addendum: 

- Recommended commercial structure (12-mo term example):
  - 35% one-time onboarding fee (covers on-prem orchestration, HSM provisioning, initial audit log ingest pipeline).
  - 45% recurring annual usage/retainer (covers hosted control plane, monitoring, auditlog storage at agreed tier).
  - 20% evidence-hold / milestones (released on delivery of specific artifacts: HSM attestation, audit pipeline proof-of-ingest, SOC2 evidence packet).

- Evidence milestones (delivery cadence):
  1) Week 2 post-PO: HSM provisioning confirmation + key escrow snapshot (artifact).
  2) Week 6: Audit pipeline ingest report + sample logs (redacted).
  3) Week 10: SOC2 evidence pack (collected artifacts + control mapping).

- Billing & credits: we can apply a 10% onboarding credit to the onboarding fee if NorthGate takes a 24-month committed volume. Alternatively, for 12–18 months we can provide a one-time implementation credit spread over first 3 invoices.

Ill put Ben on thread to confirm concessions/discount flexibility and loop Laura for legal signoff language around evidence acceptance. If that approach sounds reasonable I can draft a brief SOW amendment and milestone table (Ill attach the table).

Thanks — Soojin
Soojin Lee
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Evidence_Milestones_Table.xlsx]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Alice Green <alice.green@northgatehealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 6 Sep 2026 13:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding financial pathway and evidence handoff for NorthGate (residency + HSM + audit logs)

Looping in internal ops/engineering and legal. Tactical notes from finance/sales: 

- Concession levers we can use: up-front onboarding credit (10% of onboarding fee), extended payment terms (Net45) for first two invoices, or a volume-backed rebate applied at month 12. We prefer offering one primary concession to keep accounting clean.

- For NorthGates 7-year retention ask: long-term storage is expensive. We propose an audit-tiered model: 90 days hot, 3 years warm (compressed), remaining years cold (inexpensive archival). Price these tiers explicitly in the SOW.

- Evidence acceptance: Laura — can we approve the milestone descriptors Soojin listed as legally sufficient triggers for invoice release? Wed like one minor tweak: acceptance window of 10 business days post-delivery for NorthGate to raise any disputes; otherwise milestone considered accepted.

If Alice is comfortable with the 35/45/20 split as a starting point, my team will draft a line-item pricing worksheet and show the impact of the 10% onboarding credit vs. a 12-month rebate.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Commercial Deals, Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Alice Green <alice.green@northgatehealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding financial pathway and evidence handoff for NorthGate (residency + HSM + audit logs)

Alice / Ben / Soojin — legal is comfortable with milestone-based releases if we: 1) define the exact artifacts (file-names/types) delivered at each milestone; 2) include the 10 business-day acceptance window Ben proposed; and 3) include an explicit redaction/PII-handling appendix for the sample audit logs (we can accept redacted samples for verification).

Action items Ill take:
- Draft SOW amendment language that lists the three milestones and the file-level artifacts (e.g., NDG_HSM_Attestation.pdf, NDG_Audit_Ingest_Sample.jsonl, NDG_SOC2_Evidence_Packet.zip).
- Add a clause for retention tier pricing and an exhibit with the tier definitions (hot/warm/cold) and per-GB rates.
- Draft an acceptance certificate template NorthGate can sign after each milestone.

Soojin — Ill draft the amendment and share for your review by EOD Wed. Ben — please confirm which concession you want to land on (onboarding credit or rebate). Once we agree well update the commercial worksheet and hand to procurement.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
